subject.title: feat(android): restore in-flight runs after reconnect

question: What exact Android reconnect proof is sufficient before landing this maintainer-labeled active-run restoration PR?
rationale: The source path looks correct, but the change is native Android session/message recovery and the PR currently has replay/unit evidence only, so automation cannot decide the maintainer proof threshold.

options.title: Require Android reconnect proof
options.body: Require a redacted exact-head emulator or device artifact showing active-run restoration after Gateway reconnect and `seqGap`, including pending/send-lock state and no duplicate transcript rows.

options.title: Accept unit proof only
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally merge based on source review and replay tests, but would own the unproven native lifecycle risk.

options.title: Hold for workstream review
options.body: Pause this PR behind the broader mobile reconnect issue until Android and Apple proof expectations are aligned.

recommendation.title: Require Android reconnect proof
recommendation.body: Require a redacted exact-head emulator or device artifact showing active-run restoration after Gateway reconnect and `seqGap`, including pending/send-lock state and no duplicate transcript rows.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest routing candidate from current Android and gateway/session history and is coordinating the linked reconnect workstream.
